rca.dataFlow: The vulnerability is introduced through the PackageReference element in the csproj file, which includes a vulnerable version of SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3 (2.1.10). This dependency is not directly used in the provided code snippet but is referenced in the project file.
rca.rootCause: Line 11 of the source code specifies an outdated version of Microsoft.Data.Sqlite, which transitively depends on SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3 (2.1.10). This transitive dependency introduces a known vulnerability.
rca.securityImpact: The vulnerability could lead to arbitrary code execution if an attacker can exploit it, potentially compromising the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the application.
rca.proposedFix: Update the Microsoft.Data.Sqlite package to a version that does not depend on SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3 (2.1.10) or explicitly specify a non-vulnerable version of SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3 in the project file.
